overview: This Senate resolution recognizes the 250th anniversary of the United States Marine Corps, which by tradition was founded at Tun Tavern in Philadelphia on November 10, 1775. It honors Marines and Navy medical corpsmen who died in battle, praises those serving today, and affirms the Marine motto Semper Fidelis, meaning "Always Faithful." It invites Americans to join anniversary events and encourages communities to honor local Marines. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on November 9, 2025. It is commemorative and does not change any law or spending.
for: Supporters say the resolution fittingly honors 250 years of service and sacrifice by Marines in every major U.S. conflict.
against: Critics say the resolution is commemorative and does not change any law or spending.
